relationships.relation_statement: Set ambient dimension n=4 and hypersurface degree 2n−3=5.
relationships.evidence_location: Theorem 1, equation (8), p. 4, specialized at n=4; generic line count D4=2875.
relationships.inheritance_policy: The universal line-count formula and generic real lower bound specialize at n=4. The full symmetric monodromy theorem applies because the degree is greater than three. No sharp real minimum or maximum is inferred.
relationships.caveats: The quintic must be general in the finite reduced line-cover locus; a smooth special quintic need not have finitely many lines.

relationships.evidence_location: Definition of a Fano problem in the introduction; hypersurfaces are the one-entry multidegree case.
relationships.inheritance_policy: No automatic inheritance. A result may be transferred only after explicitly checking its hypotheses, parameter specialization, solution convention and genericity.
relationships.caveats: The cubic-surface case is the exceptional Weyl-group case, not a full-symmetric case. Use only general hypersurfaces with finite reduced line schemes.
